public_body: Pioneer Valley Chinese Immersion Charter School Board Of Trustees
overall: The AG found the charter school board violated the Open Meeting Law by omitting posting time from notices and by not notifying the AG of its notice website, but found no intentional violation and ordered only future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board's meeting notices did not record the time each notice was posted, only the date.
allegations.key_passage: The Board acknowledges that, although meeting notices included the date of posting, it failed to record on or with each notice the time of posting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to notify the Attorney General of the website where it posts meeting notices, as required by the regulations.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Board violated the Open Meeting Law as alleged in the second complaint.

allegations.summary: Second complaint asked the AG to find that the website-notification failure was an intentional violation of the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: We have not previously warned the Board against the violation found here, nor do we find other evidence that would support a finding of an intentional violation.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Law.
remedy_passage: caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Law.
